statement: No published source has been found for these days. The figures shown for them are not corroborated against a source document here, and no source has been assumed or reconstructed.
method: A day appears here only when this machine holds no PGCB workbook or converted report for it AND PGCB’s own published archive index carries no entry for it. Days the agency indexes but that have not been downloaded yet are a gap in our collection, not an absence of publication, and are excluded.
